visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male chef in a black polo shirt stands in a kitchen area, using a metal ladle to stir a steaming pot on a gas stove. Behind him, kitchen shelves and a wooden structure are visible. (2) High-angle close-ups show raw meat slices and various ingredients being cooked in separate small metal pots. Steam rises steadily from the boiling liquid. (3) Red chopsticks lift translucent noodles (hot and sour powder) from a large yellow bowl with a dark brown, rich soup. Another bowl of spicy hot pot with duck blood and tofu is shown next to it. (4) Detailed close-up shots highlight specific ingredients: a thick block of dark duck blood, a thin slice of cooked pork, and several golden fish balls resting on greens. A yellow plastic spoon scoops up some of the broth. (5) A piece of braised radish is lifted by chopsticks, revealing its juicy, cooked texture. The chef is then seen pouring a mixture of vegetables and meat from a small pot into a decorative yellow bowl. (6) A different bowl of noodles with a creamy peanut-colored sauce and meat is showcased, followed by a garlic-flavored soup bowl with cabbage. (7) The camera pans across the interior of the restaurant, showing empty wooden dining tables and chairs, with red framed art featuring theatrical masks on the wall. (8) The final shot is an exterior view of the shop at night, showing a wooden stall under a green awning with a sign reading '溫の暖湯' and text overlays providing the address.
